Name: Battleship
Author: Home Deck
Description: Turn a block of keys into a real Battleship match. Place your 3-ship fleet (sized down to fit your deck), then flip between My Fleet and Enemy Waters with the View Toggle key to defend and attack on the same grid. A Turn Indicator key shows whose turn it is -- and doubles as the rotate button while placing ships.

Actions.Name: Cell
Actions.Tooltip: One square of the shared grid -- it shows and controls whichever board the View Toggle key currently has selected (your fleet or the enemy's hunting grid). Place these in a solid rectangular block on a folder page (7 wide x 4 tall fits a Stream Deck XL).

Actions.Name: Turn Indicator
Actions.Tooltip: Shows the game's current phase: placing ships, your turn, the enemy's turn, or the match result. During ship placement, pressing this key rotates the ship you're currently positioning. Place one of these near the top-left of your grid.

Actions.Name: View Toggle
Actions.Tooltip: Switches the shared grid between My Fleet (your ships, where the enemy fires) and Enemy Waters (where you fire). Locked to My Fleet during ship placement; afterward the game also switches it for you automatically each turn. Place this near the Turn Indicator.
